name: Slider
description: Radix Slider with a track, range fill and thumb. Supports multiple thumbs for range selection.
intent: An approximate value along a continuous range, where the relative position matters more than the exact number.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Page Up/Down — step by a larger increment
Home/End — jump to min or max
requiredAttributes: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the root
aria-valuetext when the raw number is not meaningful on its own
notes: Radix sets aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow.
Set aria-valuetext when the number needs units or context — "40 percent" rather than "40".
The thumb is 20px. Its hit area is below the 44px guideline; add vertical padding to the container on touch surfaces.

forbiddenUsage: A slider as the only way to enter a precise value
A slider with fewer than ten meaningful steps
agentRules: Display the current value in text beside it — the thumb position is not readable enough alone.
For exact entry, pair with ui:input.
